description: Check to ensure phone numbers are still on WhatsApp, using this channel's own number. Use this to keep your own contacts current: check that numbers you already have are still on WhatsApp. It is not for lists of people you have never talked to. Two uses. (1) Pass `numbers` (1 to 50 per call) to start a check: it returns a job at once and keeps running in the background. (2) Pass `job_id` to read that job: its state, progress, allowance, estimate, pause reason, and a page of result rows. Each row has status (registered, not_registered, invalid, error), phone_e164, country, jid, lid, is_business and verified_name (is_business appears only when true; omitted means not known to be a verified business, never "personal"), checked_at, and cached with age_seconds. Checks run in the background and are spaced out, and each number has a daily check allowance, so a large list can take hours or days. A paused job says why in pause and resumes by itself at pause.resume_at, so do not poll it in a loop and do not start the same list again; only channel_down waits for you. A failed job reports its code and reason in failure (check_failed for an upstream failure). Numbers checked recently are answered from a cache (7 days if on WhatsApp, 24 hours if not) without asking WhatsApp or using the allowance; set refresh to ask WhatsApp again. There is no way to make a check faster. The channel must be connected and non-sandbox. ACCURACY: a check is a point-in-time answer and can be wrong or out of date by the time you use it; it is not a guarantee that a message will be delivered. The number checker is included with every paid number. The account needs at least one active non-sandbox channel, including paid, complimentary, promotional or admin grants. Without one, the service returns 403 number_checker_requires_paid_number. A sandbox request from an eligible account returns 403 number_checker_requires_non_sandbox_channel.

job_id.description: The id of a job started earlier (nck_ then 24 hex characters). Pass this instead of numbers to read it.

limit.description: With job_id: result rows to return, 1 to 2000. Default 500.

numbers.description: Phone numbers to check, 1 to 50, as you have them: a leading +, spaces and dashes are fine. Start with the country code. Omit when reading a job.

offset.description: With job_id: result rows to skip. Default 0.

refresh.description: With numbers: ask WhatsApp again even for numbers answered recently. Default false.

status.description: With job_id: only rows with these statuses.

name: check_numbers
title: Check to ensure numbers are still on WhatsApp
